us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Judge orders Trump administration to cancel taxpayer-funded promotional TV ads
bullets: A federal judge granted a temporary restraining order.
The challenge alleged misuse of taxpayer funds for political messaging.
The White House said the ad campaign was already ending.

articles.title: GOP-led states add voting rules mirroring Trump midterm proposals
bullets: Several Republican-led states changed election rules this year.
Some measures mirror Trump’s proposals for the midterms.
The changes could affect voting procedures before November elections.

articles.title: Trump returns to Ohio for GOP rally in Youngstown
bullets: Trump was scheduled to campaign in Youngstown, Ohio.
The rally comes weeks before the 2026 midterms.
Reuters listed the stop among top US political headlines.

articles.title: White House press pool dispute becomes broader free-speech fight
bullets: AP reported tensions over control of White House coverage.
The press pool rotates outlets covering the president.
The dispute centers on editorial independence and access.

articles.title: Isaias remnants move north after Gulf Coast landfall
bullets: Isaias brought heavy rain into Appalachia and the mid-Atlantic.
Forecasters warned of flooding risks in affected areas.
Southern California was also battered by Rachel.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine agree to energy ceasefire; Kyiv reports attacks
bullets: Trump said Russia and Ukraine agreed to an energy ceasefire.
Zelenskyy welcomed the announcement but said attacks continued.
AP reported strikes on Kyiv and Kharkiv infrastructure.

articles.title: Houthi strike hits Riyadh airport again, disrupting flights
bullets: A Houthi strike hit Riyadh’s international airport on October 11.
It followed another attack that killed at least 12 people.
Authorities suspended flights after the latest strike.

articles.title: Oil prices fluctuate amid Russian diesel comments and Saudi attacks
bullets: Oil markets reacted to Trump’s comments on Russian diesel.
Attacks on Saudi targets added to supply concerns.
Reuters included the story among October 12 market headlines.

articles.title: UK finance minister urges big economies to control borrowing
bullets: The UK finance minister planned remarks around global borrowing.
The comments were tied to IMF meetings.
Reuters listed the story among October 12 international headlines.

articles.title: BBC finds Kenyan mourners killed by police were not part of violence
bullets: BBC reported on deaths at an ex-prime minister’s national farewell.
The report said killed mourners were not part of violence.
The story was listed on BBC World News on October 12.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Opposition parties march to Supreme Court over voter-list revision
bullets: Hundreds marched in New Delhi on Monday.
Protesters demanded the election chief’s resignation.
Reuters said millions of names were removed from voter lists.

articles.title: Delhi-NCR hit by heavy rain and thunderstorms; IMD issues red alert
bullets: Delhi-NCR woke to heavy rain and thunderstorms.
The IMD issued a red alert for the region.
Temperatures were forecast near 32–34°C on October 13.

articles.title: Supreme Court stresses due process as Delhi protest detentions continue
bullets: About 700 people were detained during Delhi protests Sunday.
The Supreme Court said detentions must be lawful.
Opposition groups vowed to continue demonstrations.

articles.title: RBI measures seek to defend rupee near record lows
bullets: Reuters said the rupee has fallen more than 7% this year.
The RBI opened a special dollar window for oil companies.
Officials also tightened hedging rules to ease pressure.

articles.title: ED raids eight Kolkata locations in money-laundering probe
bullets: The Enforcement Directorate raided multiple Kolkata premises Monday.
Searches included Tollygunge and Sarat Bose Road locations.
The action was part of a money-laundering investigation.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Notable US stock and market movers

articles.title: Humana jumps about 11% in early US trading
bullets: Humana traded at $431.87 around 13:10 UTC.
The stock was up $43.53 from the prior close.
CNBC also flagged Humana as a major recent mover.

articles.title: Apple slips as tech stocks remain under pressure
bullets: Apple traded at $336.64 around 13:11 UTC.
Shares were down about 1.14% from the prior close.
CNBC listed Apple among notable premarket movers.

articles.title: Nvidia edges lower as AI spending concerns linger
bullets: Nvidia traded at $229.28 around 13:11 UTC.
Shares were down about 0.49% from the prior close.
Reuters cited worries over AI spending and elevated yields.

articles.title: JPMorgan rises ahead of major US bank earnings
bullets: JPMorgan traded at $332.99 around 13:08 UTC.
Shares were up about 0.48% from the prior close.
Reuters said JPMorgan reports quarterly results on October 13.

articles.title: Tesla gains about 2% in early trading
bullets: Tesla traded at $382.70 around 13:11 UTC.
Shares were up $7.80 from the prior close.
The move came amid broader choppy equity trading.

articles.title: US bank earnings to test effects of higher rates and deal outlook
bullets: JPMorgan, Goldman, Citi and Wells Fargo report October 13.
Investors will watch funding costs and lending growth.
Reuters said dealmaking outlook is a key focus.

articles.title: Global shares choppy as earnings season approaches
bullets: Reuters said markets began Monday erratically.
Investors are testing high tech valuations.
Oil slipped amid Russia-Ukraine energy uncertainty.

articles.title: European shares rise as oil eases and banks gain
bullets: European shares rose Monday, led by banks.
Lower oil prices supported sentiment.
Investors awaited the start of earnings season.

articles.title: HCLTech signs pact with Anthropic and plans new business unit
bullets: Reuters listed the HCLTech-Anthropic pact on October 12.
The Indian IT firm plans a dedicated business unit.
The deal reflects corporate demand for AI services.

articles.title: Thomson Reuters schedules third-quarter earnings webcast
bullets: Thomson Reuters set its Q3 2026 earnings date.
The webcast is scheduled for November 3, 2026.
The company recently completed a KKR print-business joint venture.

articles.title: Silicon Valley AI founders cheer Trump’s self-policing approach
bullets: AP reported AI founders supported lighter federal regulation.
The story was tied to San Francisco Tech Week.
Trump has favored industry-led AI safety approaches.

articles.title: FBI seizes tools used by Chinese-linked hackers
bullets: Officials said seized tools enabled scanning and phishing.
The hacking group was associated with China’s government.
Targets included power, academia and critical infrastructure.

articles.title: AP-NORC poll finds most Americans say AI is developing too fast
bullets: The poll found AI concerns cut across party lines.
Respondents prioritized human control and worker protections.
Trump has warned against slowing AI development.

articles.title: Ukraine drone attack shuts down Yandex data center in Vladimir
bullets: AP reported the attack east of Moscow.
The facility was run by Russian tech giant Yandex.
The strike came amid wider Russia-Ukraine infrastructure attacks.

articles.title: Super Micro contractor pleads guilty in AI server diversion scheme
bullets: The contractor pleaded guilty in US federal court.
The case involved advanced AI servers with Nvidia chips.
Authorities said servers were diverted to Chinese entities.
